data.title: Bitcoin, Solana, XRP Tumble Ahead Of CPI – And Retail Traders Aren’t Feeling Bullish
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Solana (SOL), and Ripple’s (XRP) token fell Friday morning, extending a rough week for major cryptocurrencies even as U.S. stock futures pointed to a higher open ahead of the August CPI report.Bitcoin’s price fell 1.5% over the past 24 hours, while Zcash (ZEC) led losses among major…
